name: sc
description: SwarmCloud from inside a Claude Code session. Two skills: `sc` reads the cluster -- the account pool and its quota windows, which pool actually binds each runner profile, what is running, what is wrong -- and never writes. `delegate` owns the decision to run work remotely instead of locally, dispatches it by runner-profile NAME from the frozen catalogue, reports a failure as something actionable rather than a task id, and brings the result back into the working tree. It writes, so it says when it asks first. Both use the swarm-mcp bridge, which the plugin fetches from GitHub at the tag matching this version: it needs uv, not a checkout.
